sql: with o as (select market_ticker, strategy, max(limit_price) as px, sum(quantity) as qty from live_orders where strategy in ('Nmmsell10','Kmmsell10') and status='filled' and created_at >= '2026-10-16 14:11' group by 1,2), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), s as (select o.*, p.pos, p.realized_pnl, case when p.pos=0 then case when p.realized_pnl<0 then -o.qty*o.px/100.0 else o.qty*(100-o.px)/100.0 end end as tag_pnl from o left join p using (market_ticker)) select 'live '||strategy as book, count(*) as filled_mkts, count(*) filter (where pos=0) as settled, count(*) filter (where pos=0 and realized_pnl<0) as losers, round(sum(tag_pnl)::numeric,2) as usd from s group by 1 union all select 'paper '||strategy, count(distinct market_ticker), count(*) filter (where status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')), count(*) filter (where status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and pnl<0), round(sum(coalesce(pnl,0))::numeric,2) from paper_trades where strategy in ('Nmmsell10_pt4','Pmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-10-16' group by 1 order by 1
